sections.title: A new-joiner social, start to finish.

steps.title: One private link
steps.body: Post it in the team channel. It stays off public pages; only people with the link can RSVP.

steps.title: Two quick questions
steps.body: Which team, and how long they’ve been here. That’s all {{brand.name}} needs to mix the groups.

steps.title: A nudge in the team channel
steps.body: Post where, when and what to expect. Colleagues using the app also get a reminder 15 minutes before it starts.

steps.title: Check in, then mix
steps.body: Colleagues scan in and see their first group. A few rounds later, everyone’s met people outside their team.

steps.title: A report for leadership
steps.body: Who came, how many new people each person met, and what they thought, in a few lines.

sections.title: for socials your company pays for. Free events stay free.
sections.trial: If colleagues buy a ticket, say for an optional trip, it’s 5% of what they pay, never more than ₹10,000 a month. Payment gateway fees are separate.

examples.title: A new-joiner social for 60
examples.body: Your company pays the venue; nobody buys a ticket.

examples.title: A monthly team social
examples.body: Every month, as long as it’s free to attend.

items.question: Is it really free?
items.answer: Yes, if nobody pays to attend. {{brand.name}} charges 5% only when people buy tickets, and free events stay free.

items.question: Can we keep it to our company?
items.answer: Yes. Make the event invite-only: it stays off public pages and only people with your private link can RSVP.

items.question: Do colleagues need an app?
items.answer: No. They RSVP, check in and see their group in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can you run a multi-day offsite?
items.answer: Yes, with programmes: arrivals, transport, rooms, forms and messages for everyone attending. Ask us for a walkthrough and we’ll set it up with you.

items.question: Can we hire a host to run it?
items.answer: Not through {{brand.name}} yet. Many quiz, supper and run hosts on {{brand.name}} run private events; message them from their page.

items.question: What does the report show?
items.answer: Who RSVP’d and came, and, if you ask for feedback, ratings and how many new people they met. It never shows anyone’s private answers.
